messages:
Leah Kim: Thanks for joining the strategy segment today \- dropping a live thread for quick follow-ups.
Asha Patel: Single Q: which metric is top priority this quarter? p95 latency, $/1M tokens, or enterprise ARR?
Leah Kim: Priorities = 1) SLA/reliability, 2) unit cost for hosted, 3) PLG activation. OKRs will be shared tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
Diego Ramos: For product teams: prioritize Optimize (batching/quant) or accelerate Dedicated region work?
Leah Kim: Sequence: Optimize (fast margin wins) -> Dedicated scaling (enterprise GTM) -> Private/VPC work.
Maya Chen: Messaging ask: keep "production-first" as umbrella, or lean into "cost-optimized inference" for infra buyers?
Leah Kim: Keep production-first overall; produce persona-focused collateral that emphasizes cost & SLOs for platform buyers.
Sam Carter: Sales enablement request: can we get a 1-pager with the two personas + top KPIs?
Leah Kim: Yes \- drafting a 1-pager in 48h with sample KPIs (p95 target, $/1M tokens, MTTI).
Asha Patel: Concrete example of fallbacks? model variant + region failover?
Leah Kim: Example: primary = rlx-1 (us), fallback = rlx-1-q (eu) -> then lower-cost tier. Routing policy: local -> remote -> fallback. Diagram to follow.
allhands-bot: Slides + recording: https://redwood.slides/all-hands/1774509876
Leah Kim: Will post OKRs and a short Q&A doc by EOD tomorrow. Keep questions here.
